s: Yima brings fatness and flocks (down to the world created by Mazda)
q: that I may bring fatness and flocks down to the world created by Mazda;

s: Yima brings immortality (down to the world created by Mazda)
q: that I may bring immortality down to the world created by Mazda;

s: Yima takes away hunger and thirst (from the world created by Mazda)
q: That I may take away both hunger and thirst, from the world created by Mazda;

s: Thraêtaona is a heir (of the valiant Âthwya clan)
q: To her did Thraêtaona, the heir of the valiant Âthwya clan, offer up a sacrifice in the four-cornered Varena.

s: Thraêtaona obtains boon granted by Ashi Vanguhi
q: Thraêtaona, the heir of the valiant Âthwya clan, obtained that boon.

s: Azi Dahâka is a three-mouthed, three-headed, six-eyed fiendish Drug
q: that I may overcome Azi Dahâka, the three-mouthed, the three-headed, the six-eyed, who has a thousand senses, that most powerful, fiendish Drug,

s: Ashi Vanguhi is worthy of sacrifice well worthy of sacrifice
q: We sacrifice to Ashi Vanguhi, who is shining, high, tall-formed, well worthy of sacrifice, with a loud-sounding chariot, strong, welfare-giving, healing, with fulness of intellect, and powerful;

s: Azi Dahâka has a thousand senses
q: who has a thousand senses,

s: the Drug is created by Angra Mainyu (against the material world)
q: the strongest Drug that Angra Mainyu created against the material world, to destroy the world of the good principle;

s: Franghrasyan is a Turanian murderer
q: that I may bind the Turanian murderer, Franghrasyan,

s: Husravah is a king
q: that king Husravah may kill him, behind the Kaêkasta lake,

s: Husravah unites Aryan nations (into one kingdom)
q: To her did the gallant Husravah, he who united the Aryan nations into one kingdom, offer up a sacrifice,

s: Husravah obtains boon granted by Ashi Vanguhi
q: The gallant Husravah, he who united the Aryan nations into one kingdom, obtained that boon.

s: Hutaosa is a good and noble
q: that I may bring the good and noble Hutaosa to think according to the law,

s: Hutaosa thinks according to good Law of the worshippers of Mazda (desired disposition)
q: that I may bring the good and noble Hutaosa to think according to the law, to speak according to the law, to do according to the law,

s: Vîstâspa is tall tall
q: To her did the tall Kavi Vîstâspa offer up a sacrifice behind the waters of the river Dâitya.

s: Vîstâspa obtains boon granted by Ashi Vanguhi
q: the tall Kavi Vîstâspa obtained that boon.

s: Ashi Vanguhi has chariot loud-sounding chariot
q: We sacrifice to Ashi Vanguhi, who is shining, high, tall-formed, well worthy of sacrifice, with a loud-sounding chariot, strong, welfare-giving, healing, with fulness of intellect, and powerful;

s: Vîstâspa puts to flight Asta-aurvant
q: that I may put to flight Asta-aurvant, the son of Vîspô-thaurvô-asti, the all-afflicting, of the brazen helmet, of the brazen armour, of the thick neck,

s: courtezan is a woman who produces untimely issues
q: which are sent to me either by a man whose seed is dried out, or by the courtezan who produces untimely issues,

s: courtezan destroys her fruit
q: The first wailing of the great Ashi Vanguhi is her wailing about the courtezan who destroys her fruit:

s: courtezan brings forth child conceived of a stranger
q: The second wailing of the great Ashi Vanguhi is her wailing about the courtezan who brings forth a child conceived of a stranger and presents it to her husband:

s: sacrifice to Ashi Vanguhi includes libations
q: We sacrifice unto Ashi Vanguhi with the libations; with the Haoma and meat, with the baresma, with the wisdom of the tongue, with the holy spells, with the words, with the deeds, with the libations, and with the rightly-spoken words.

s: sacrifice to Ashi Vanguhi includes Haoma and meat
q: We sacrifice unto Ashi Vanguhi with the libations; with the Haoma and meat, with the baresma, with the wisdom of the tongue, with the holy spells, with the words, with the deeds, with the libations, and with the rightly-spoken words.

s: Ashi Vanguhi is strong strong
q: We sacrifice to Ashi Vanguhi, who is shining, high, tall-formed, well worthy of sacrifice, with a loud-sounding chariot, strong, welfare-giving, healing, with fulness of intellect, and powerful;

s: boon granted by Ashi Vanguhi is obtained by Haoshyangha
q: The great Ashi Vanguhi ran and came to his side: Haoshyangha, the Paradhâta, obtained that boon.

s: boon granted by Ashi Vanguhi is obtained by Yima
q: Yima Khshaêta, the good shepherd, obtained that boon.

s: boon granted by Ashi Vanguhi is obtained by Thraêtaona
q: Thraêtaona, the heir of the valiant Âthwya clan, obtained that boon.

s: boon granted by Ashi Vanguhi is obtained by Husravah
q: The gallant Husravah, he who united the Aryan nations into one kingdom, obtained that boon.

s: boon granted by Ashi Vanguhi is obtained by Vîstâspa
q: the tall Kavi Vîstâspa obtained that boon.

s: good Law of the worshippers of Mazda is a law of holiness
q: Yathâ ahû vairyô: The will of the Lord is the law of holiness . . . .

s: Ashi Vanguhi is welfare giving welfare-giving
q: We sacrifice to Ashi Vanguhi, who is shining, high, tall-formed, well worthy of sacrifice, with a loud-sounding chariot, strong, welfare-giving, healing, with fulness of intellect, and powerful;

s: Âstâd Yast is a Yast
q: XVIII. Âstâd Yast.

s: Aryan Glory is made by Ahura Mazda
q: I made the Aryan Glory, rich in food, rich in flocks, rich in wealth, rich in Glory; provided with full store of intelligence, with full store of money, to withstand Need, and to withstand enemies.

s: Aryan Glory destroys Angra Mainyu (who is all death)
q: It destroys Angra Mainyu, who is all death: it destroys Aêshma, the fiend of the wounding spear; it destroys the yellow Bûshyãsta; it destroys the contagion of Aêkha; it destroys the fiend of death, Apaosha; it destroys the non-Aryan nations.

s: Aryan Glory destroys Aêshma (the fiend of the wounding spear)
q: It destroys Angra Mainyu, who is all death: it destroys Aêshma, the fiend of the wounding spear; it destroys the yellow Bûshyãsta; it destroys the contagion of Aêkha; it destroys the fiend of death, Apaosha; it destroys the non-Aryan nations.

s: Aryan Glory destroys Bûshyãsta (yellow)
q: It destroys Angra Mainyu, who is all death: it destroys Aêshma, the fiend of the wounding spear; it destroys the yellow Bûshyãsta; it destroys the contagion of Aêkha; it destroys the fiend of death, Apaosha; it destroys the non-Aryan nations.

s: Aryan Glory destroys Aêkha (as contagion)
q: It destroys Angra Mainyu, who is all death: it destroys Aêshma, the fiend of the wounding spear; it destroys the yellow Bûshyãsta; it destroys the contagion of Aêkha; it destroys the fiend of death, Apaosha; it destroys the non-Aryan nations.

s: Aryan Glory destroys Apaosha (the fiend of death)
q: It destroys Angra Mainyu, who is all death: it destroys Aêshma, the fiend of the wounding spear; it destroys the yellow Bûshyãsta; it destroys the contagion of Aêkha; it destroys the fiend of death, Apaosha; it destroys the non-Aryan nations.

s: Aryan Glory destroys non-Aryan nations
q: It destroys Angra Mainyu, who is all death: it destroys Aêshma, the fiend of the wounding spear; it destroys the yellow Bûshyãsta; it destroys the contagion of Aêkha; it destroys the fiend of death, Apaosha; it destroys the non-Aryan nations.

s: Ashi Vanguhi is a Ashi (great)
q: And I made the great Ashi Vanguhi; she comes in, amid the family; she comes in, inside the fine royal palace.

s: Ashi Vanguhi comes in family (with fulness of welfare)
q: Let Ashi, with fulness of welfare, follow the man who gladdens the faithful with his gifts! she comes in, inside his family; she comes in, inside his fine royal palace.

s: Ashi Vanguhi comes in fine royal palace
q: Let Ashi, with fulness of welfare, follow the man who gladdens the faithful with his gifts! she comes in, inside his family; she comes in, inside his fine royal palace.

s: Ahura Mazda speaks to Zarathustra
q: Ahura Mazda spake unto Spitama Zarathustra, saying:

s: Ashi Vanguhi puts one foot inside family (with all sorts of flocks, with all victory, with all intelligence, with all Glory)
q: With all sorts of flocks, with all victory, with all intelligence, with all Glory, the great Ashi Vanguhi puts one foot inside his family; she comes in, inside his fine royal palace.

s: Tistrya is a star (bright and glorious)
q: as) the bright, glorious star Tistrya moves on equally

s: Tistrya moves on equally
q: as) the bright, glorious star Tistrya moves on equally

s: Aryan Glory brings increase to mountains (on the tops of all mountains)
q: And they bring increase on the tops of all mountains, down the depths of all vales; they bring increase to all the growing plants, the fair, the golden-hued.

s: Aryan Glory brings increase to vales (down the depths of all vales)
q: And they bring increase on the tops of all mountains, down the depths of all vales; they bring increase to all the growing plants, the fair, the golden-hued.

s: Aryan Glory brings increase to plants (fair and golden-hued)
q: And they bring increase on the tops of all mountains, down the depths of all vales; they bring increase to all the growing plants, the fair, the golden-hued.

s: Holiness is a good (the best of all)
q: Ashem Vohû: Holiness is the best of all good . . . .

s: Yathâ ahû vairyô is a will of the Lord
q: Yathâ ahû vairyô; The will of the Lord is the law of holiness . . . .

s: Aryan Glory is a glory (made by Mazda)
q: I made the Aryan Glory, rich in food, rich in flocks, rich in wealth, rich in Glory; provided with full store of intelligence, with full store of money, to withstand Need, and to withstand enemies.

s: Aryan Glory is rich in food
q: I made the Aryan Glory, rich in food, rich in flocks, rich in wealth, rich in Glory; provided with full store of intelligence, with full store of money, to withstand Need, and to withstand enemies.

s: Aryan Glory is rich in flocks
q: I made the Aryan Glory, rich in food, rich in flocks, rich in wealth, rich in Glory; provided with full store of intelligence, with full store of money, to withstand Need, and to withstand enemies.

s: Aryan Glory is rich in wealth
q: I made the Aryan Glory, rich in food, rich in flocks, rich in wealth, rich in Glory; provided with full store of intelligence, with full store of money, to withstand Need, and to withstand enemies.

s: Aryan Glory is rich in Glory
q: I made the Aryan Glory, rich in food, rich in flocks, rich in wealth, rich in Glory; provided with full store of intelligence, with full store of money, to withstand Need, and to withstand enemies.

s: Aryan Glory has full store of intelligence
q: I made the Aryan Glory, rich in food, rich in flocks, rich in wealth, rich in Glory; provided with full store of intelligence, with full store of money, to withstand Need, and to withstand enemies.

s: Aryan Glory has full store of money
q: I made the Aryan Glory, rich in food, rich in flocks, rich in wealth, rich in Glory; provided with full store of intelligence, with full store of money, to withstand Need, and to withstand enemies.

s: Ahura Mazda is a creator
q: namely, the Maker, Ahura Mazda.

s: good Law of the worshippers of Mazda is unconquerable power (in its dominion)
q: for the righteousness of the law, for the innocence of the law, for the unconquerable power of the law;

s: awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda is a glory (made by Mazda)
q: We sacrifice unto the awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda;

s: awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda is most conquering
q: We sacrifice unto the awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda; most conquering, highly working, that possesses health, wisdom, and happiness, and is more powerful to destroy than all other creatures;

s: awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda possesses health
q: most conquering, highly working, that possesses health, wisdom, and happiness, and is more powerful to destroy than all other creatures;

s: awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda possesses wisdom
q: most conquering, highly working, that possesses health, wisdom, and happiness, and is more powerful to destroy than all other creatures;

s: awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda possesses happiness
q: most conquering, highly working, that possesses health, wisdom, and happiness, and is more powerful to destroy than all other creatures;

s: awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda cannot be forcibly seized not forcibly seizable
q: We sacrifice unto the awful Glory, that cannot be forcibly seized, made by Mazda . . . .

s: awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda belongs to Aryan nations (born and unborn)
q: wishing to seize that Glory that belongs to the Aryan nations, born and unborn, and to the holy Zarathustra.

s: awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda belongs to Zarathustra (holy)
q: wishing to seize that Glory that belongs to the Aryan nations, born and unborn, and to the holy Zarathustra.

s: Ahura Mazda creates the creation (many, good, fair, wonderful, prosperous, and bright)
q: That belongs to Ahura Mazda, as (through it) Ahura Mazda made the creatures, many and good, many and fair, many and wonderful, many and prosperous

s: awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda cleaves to Yima (for a long time while he ruled)
q: That clave unto the bright Yima, the good shepherd, for a long time, while he ruled over the seven Karshvares of the earth,

s: awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda cleaves to Mithra (after departing from Yima)
q: Then Mithra seized that Glory, Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, whose ear is quick to hear, who has a thousand senses.

s: awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda cleaves to Thraêtaona (after departing from Yima)
q: Then Thraêtaona seized that Glory, he, the heir of the valiant Âthwya clan, who was the most victorious of all victorious men next to Zarathustra;

s: awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda cleaves to Keresâspa (after departing from Yima)
q: Then the manly-hearted Keresâspa seized that Glory; he who was the sturdiest of the men of strength, next to Zarathustra, for his manly courage.

s: the good restoration of the world is ever living (after restoration)
q: So that they may restore the world, which will (thenceforth) never grow old and never die, never decaying and never rotting, ever living and ever increasing, and master of its wish,

s: the good restoration of the world includes the resurrection of the dead
q: when the dead will rise, when life and immortality will come, and the world will be restored at its wish;

s: the good restoration of the world includes immortality
q: when the dead will rise, when life and immortality will come, and the world will be restored at its wish;

s: the creation becomes deathless (prosperous creation of the Good Spirit)
q: When the creation will grow deathless,—the prosperous creation of the Good Spirit,—

s: the creation is prosperous (of the Good Spirit)
q: When the creation will grow deathless,—the prosperous creation of the Good Spirit,—

s: the Drug is a fiendish Drug (created against the material world)
q: that most powerful, fiendish Drug; that demon baleful to the world, the strongest Drug that Angra Mainyu created against the material world, to destroy the world of the good principle.

s: Ahura Mazda is father and commander of Amesha-Spentas
q: whose father and commander is the same, namely, the Maker, Ahura Mazda.

s: the Drug perishes perished (with her hundredfold brood)
q: and the Drug shall perish, though she may rush on every side to kill the holy beings; she and her hundredfold brood shall perish, as it is the will of the Lord.

s: Angra Mainyu creates the Drug (against the material world)
q: the strongest Drug that Angra Mainyu created against the material world, to destroy the world of the good principle.

s: Good Spirit has creation the prosperous creation
q: When the creation will grow deathless,—the prosperous creation of the Good Spirit,—

s: Good Spirit struggles for awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda (against the Evil One)
q: For which the Good Spirit and the Evil One did struggle with one another: for that Glory that cannot be forcibly seized they flung each of them. their darts most swift.

s: Daêvas are driven beneath the earth (by the Ahuna Vairya)
q: drove back all the Daêvas beneath the earth, and took off from them sacrifice and prayer.

s: Amesha-Spentas is a seven bright ones (holy and undecaying)
q: That belongs to the Amesha-Spentas, the bright ones, whose looks perform their wish, tall, quickly coming to do, strong, lordly, who are undecaying and holy;

s: Amesha-Spentas are of one thought (all seven)
q: Who are all seven of one thought, who are all seven of one speech, who are all seven of one deed;

s: Amesha-Spentas are of one speech (all seven)
q: Who are all seven of one thought, who are all seven of one speech, who are all seven of one deed;

s: Amesha-Spentas are of one deed (all seven)
q: Who are all seven of one thought, who are all seven of one speech, who are all seven of one deed;

s: Amesha-Spentas govern the creation (as makers, governors, shapers, overseers, keepers, and preservers)
q: Who are the makers and governors, the shapers and overseers, the keepers and preservers of these creations of Ahura Mazda.

s: Aryan nations are born and unborn
q: wishing to seize that Glory that belongs to the Aryan nations, born and unborn, and to the holy Zarathustra.

s: seven Karshvares of the earth is of the earth
q: while he ruled over the seven Karshvares of the earth,

s: Mount Haraiti Barez is a mountain (first to rise out of the earth)
q: The first mountain that rose up out of the earth, O Spitama Zarathustra! was the Haraiti Barez.

s: Mount Haraiti Barez stretches along the land washed by waters (towards the east)
q: That mountain stretches all along the shores of the land washed by waters towards the east.

s: Mount Ushi-dhau Ushi-darena is a mountain (one of the mountains that grew up after Mount Zeredhô)
q: From there grew up Mount Ushi-dhau Ushi-darena, Mount Erezifya, and Mount Fraorepa.

s: Mount Ushi-darena is a mountain (seat of holy happiness)
q: Unto Mount Ushi-darena, made by Mazda, the seat of holy happiness;

s: Mount Ushi-darena is made by Ahura Mazda
q: Unto Mount Ushi-darena, made by Mazda, the seat of holy happiness;

s: the sea Vouru-Kasha contains Lake Husravah (formed as an arm of the sea)
q: and an arm of the sea Vouru-Kasha was produced, namely, that lake that is called Lake Husravah.

s: the sea Vouru-Kasha contains Lake Vanghazdau (formed as an arm of the sea)
q: and an arm of the sea Vouru-Kasha was produced, namely, that lake that is called Lake Vanghazdau.

s: Ahura Mazda opposes Frangrasyan (ever eager to create new creatures)
q: —'Ahura Mazda will come against thee, ever eager to create new creatures.'

s: the sea Vouru-Kasha contains Awz-dânva (formed as an arm of the sea)
q: and an arm was produced in the sea Vouru-Kasha, namely, the water that is called Awz-dânva.

s: the Son of the Waters is a male god (swift-horsed, tall, and shining)
q: We sacrifice unto the Son of the Waters, the swift-horsed, the tall and shining lord, the lord of females; the male god, who helps one at his appeal;

s: the Son of the Waters lives beneath waters
q: a god who lives beneath waters, and whose ear is the quickest to hear when he is worshipped.

s: Yima is a good shepherd (bright)
q: That clave unto the bright Yima, the good shepherd, for a long time,

s: Yima rules seven Karshvares of the earth (for a long time)
q: while he ruled over the seven Karshvares of the earth,

s: Yima has awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda (until he delighted in falsehood and untruth)
q: But when he began to find delight in words of falsehood and untruth, the Glory was seen to flee away from him in the shape of a bird.

s: Yima is son of Vîvanghant
q: The first time when the Glory departed from the bright Yima, the Glory went from Yima, the son of Vîvanghant, in the shape of a Vâraghna bird.

s: Mithra is lord of wide pastures
q: Then Mithra seized that Glory, Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, whose ear is quick to hear, who has a thousand senses.

s: Mithra seizes awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda (after its first departure from Yima)
q: Then Mithra seized that Glory, Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, whose ear is quick to hear, who has a thousand senses.

s: Thraêtaona is a victorious man (most victorious next to Zarathustra)
q: who was the most victorious of all victorious men next to Zarathustra;

s: Thraêtaona seizes awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda (after its second departure from Yima)
q: Then Thraêtaona seized that Glory, he, the heir of the valiant Âthwya clan, who was the most victorious of all victorious men next to Zarathustra;

s: Thraêtaona kills Azi Dahâka (the three-mouthed, three-headed, six-eyed fiendish Drug)
q: Who smote Azi Dahâka, the three-mouthed, the three-headed, the six-eyed, who had a thousand senses, that most powerful, fiendish Drug;

s: Azi Dahâka is a fiendish Drug (three-mouthed, three-headed, six-eyed, and having a thousand senses)
q: Who smote Azi Dahâka, the three-mouthed, the three-headed, the six-eyed, who had a thousand senses, that most powerful, fiendish Drug;

s: Azi Dahâka is created by Angra Mainyu (against the material world)
q: the strongest Drug that Angra Mainyu created against the material world, to destroy the world of the good principle.

s: Keresâspa is a man of strength (sturdiest next to Zarathustra in manly courage)
q: Then the manly-hearted Keresâspa seized that Glory; he who was the sturdiest of the men of strength, next to Zarathustra, for his manly courage.

s: Keresâspa seizes awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda (after its third departure from Yima)
q: Then the manly-hearted Keresâspa seized that Glory;

s: Keresâspa has Manly Courage (firm of foot, unsleeping, quick to rise, and fully awake)
q: For Manly Courage clave unto him. We worship Manly Courage, firm or foot, unsleeping, quick to rise, and fully awake, that clave unto Keresâspa;

s: Keresâspa kills Srvara (horse-devouring and men-devouring yellow poisonous snake)
q: Who killed the snake Srvara, the horse-devouring, men-devouring, yellow, poisonous snake, over which yellow poison flowed a thumb's breadth thick.

s: Keresâspa kills Gandarewa (golden-heeled)
q: Who killed the golden-heeled Gandarewa, that was rushing with open jaws, eager to destroy the living world of the good principle;

s: Manly Courage is a courage (firm of foot, unsleeping, quick to rise, and fully awake)
q: We worship Manly Courage, firm or foot, unsleeping, quick to rise, and fully awake, that clave unto Keresâspa;

s: Zarathustra follows good Law of the worshippers of Mazda (holy)
q: That clave unto the holy Zarathustra, so that he thought according to the Law, spake according to the Law, and did according to the Law;

s: Âtar is a son of Ahura Mazda
q: The Good Spirit flung a dart, and so did Vohu-Manô, and Asha-Vahista and Âtar, the son of Ahura Mazda.

s: Âtar struggles for awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda (against Azi Dahâka)
q: Then forward came Âtar, the son of Ahura Mazda, thinking thus in his heart: 'I want to seize that Glory that cannot be forcibly seized.'

s: Âtar protects the Good Principle (by blazing in Azi Dahâka's jaws if necessary)
q: then I will enter thy hinder part, I will blaze up in thy jaws, so that thou mayest never more rush upon the earth made by Mazda and destroy the world of the good principle.'

s: Frangrasyan is a Turanian ruffian (most crafty)
q: Which the Turanian ruffian Frangrasyan tried to seize in the sea Vouru-Kasha.

s: Frangrasyan tries to seize awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda (in the sea Vouru-Kasha, three times)
q: A third time he stripped himself naked, wishing to seize the Glory that belongs to the Aryan nations, born and unborn, and to the holy Zarathustra.

s: Frangrasyan fails to seize awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda (three times)
q: He was not able to seize the Glory that belongs to the Aryan nations, born and unborn, and to the holy Zarathustra.

s: Husravah is a king (lord and victorious over all)
q: the lord Kavi Husravah prevailed over all;

s: Husravah has Victory (for the well-shapen Strength and crushing Ascendant)
q: That clave unto Kavi Husravah for the well-shapen Strength, for the Victory made by Ahura, for the crushing Ascendant;

s: Husravah defeats Frangrasyan (put him in bonds)
q: the lord Kavi Husravah prevailed over all; he put in bonds Frangrasyan and Keresavazda,

s: Ahuna Vairya is a prayer (sung and repeated four times by Zarathustra)
q: And that one prayer, the Ahuna Vairya, which the holy Zarathustra sang and repeated four times, with a song that waxed louder and louder,

s: Zarathustra has awful kingly Glory, made by Mazda (holy)
q: That clave unto the holy Zarathustra, so that he thought according to the Law, spake according to the Law, and did according to the Law;

s: Ahuna Vairya drives back Daêvas (beneath the earth)
q: drove back all the Daêvas beneath the earth, and took off from them sacrifice and prayer.

s: Victory cleaves to Husravah (day after day)
q: and Victory will cleave unto him, day after day;

s: Victory enables Husravah (to conquer the havocking hordes and all who hate him)
q: Attended by that Victory, he will conquer the havocking hordes; attended by that Victory, he will conquer all those who hate him.

s: the Good Principle is a good principle (the world it protects)
q: that most powerful, fiendish Drug; that demon baleful to the world, the strongest Drug that Angra Mainyu created against the material world, to destroy the world of the good principle.

s: Zarathustra is the holiest in holiness (in all the living world)
q: so that he was the holiest in holiness in all the living world, the best-ruling in exercising rule, the brightest in brightness, the most glorious in glory, the most victorious in victory.

s: Vendidad (Vendîdâd) has title Vendidad (Vendîdâd)
Vendidad (Vendîdâd) has source class canonical
Ahura Mazda is a Maker
q: 'Demand of me, thou upright one! of me, who am the Maker, the best of all beings, the most knowing, the most pleased in answering what is asked of me; demand of me, that thou mayst be the better, that thou mayst be the happier.'

s: sacred girdle is not worn the man (for three years)
q: ‘It is the man that teaches a wrong law; it is the man who continues for three years without wearing the sacred girdle, without chanting the Gâthas, without worshipping the good waters.

s: Haoma is given to Ashemaogha (wicked and ungodly)
q: ‘Whosoever should give some Haoma juice to a wicked, ungodly Ashemaogha, or some Myazda consecrated with blessings, does no better deed than if he should lead a thousand horse against the cities of the worshippers of Mazda, and should slaughter the men thereof, and drive off the cattle as plunder.

s: Myazda is given to Ashemaogha (consecrated with blessings)
q: ‘Whosoever should give some Haoma juice to a wicked, ungodly Ashemaogha, or some Myazda consecrated with blessings, does no better deed than if he should lead a thousand horse against the cities of the worshippers of Mazda, and should slaughter the men thereof, and drive off the cattle as plunder.

s: Sraosha is a holy, strong (incarnate Word; mighty-speared and lordly god)

s: Drug bears offspring progeny (through four males)
q: ‘There are four males who are mine. 'And they make me conceive progeny as other males make their females.'

s: Drug has as male man who withholds treasured riches (first male)
q: Then the Drug demon, the guileful one, answered: ‘O holy, tall-formed Sraosha! He is the first of my males who, being entreated by one of the faithful, does not give him anything, be it ever so little, of the riches he has treasured up.

s: Drug has as male man who urinates on upper forepart of foot (second male)

s: Drug has as male man who emits seed during sleep (third male)

s: Drug has as male person over fifteen without sacred girdle and sacred shirt (fourth male; man or woman)

s: atonement requires thirty bridges (over canals)

s: atonement leads to world of the holy ones (if paid)
